name: NIT Warangal and NIMS Hyderabad intraoperative C-arm sets (2D-3D-sci-registration)
what: nine living patients and 51 AP and lateral C-arm sets in the repository's README (at most 49 unique frames), a Ziehm C-arm, preoperative CT with level-named L1 to L5 centroids; the 60 centroid files and 54 overlay PNGs (the real frame at 8 bits beside a simulated projection) are public on the repository, the CT and raw X-rays available upon reasonable request
level_truth: L1 to L5 centroids named by level, from the preoperative CT
licence: not recorded; the raw frames and CTs are available upon reasonable request
how_to_get: Write to the authors named on the repository and the manuscript (National Institute of Technology Warangal; Nizam's Institute of Medical Sciences, Hyderabad), to confirm; the letter is letters/nit_warangal_nims.md.
A yes brings whatever agreement the authors ask for, which the owner signs, then a transfer by link, fetched as a grid job on the owner's word.
record: SchwingNet docs/research/xray-dataset-requests.md section 15 (2026-10-21); no record under SchwingNet's data/sources/ existed for this set, so this one was written from that section
source_status: a letter sent 2026-10-21; no record in SchwingNet's registry yet
result: Letter sent 2026-10-21 09:46 UTC by the owner; waiting for the answer.
